verses.en: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.
verses.sm: Papelonia, na fetagisi ai lava i matou, ina ua matou manatua Siona.

verses.en: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.
verses.sm: Ua matou tautauina a matou kitara i luga o garava ua i ai.

verses.en: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.
verses.sm: Aua na inoino mai ia te i matou i lea mea o e na taʻitaʻi ia i matou i le tafeaga, ia matou pepese i upu o le pese; o i latou foi na faatiga mai ia i matou, ua inoino mai ia olioli, ua faapea mai, la outou pepese mai ia i matou ni pese a Siona.

verses.en: How shall we sing the LORD'S song in a strange land?
verses.sm: Pe faapefea ona matou pepese le pese i le ALII i le nuu ese?

verses.en: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.
verses.sm: lerusalema e, afai e galo oe ia te au, ia galo lava i loʻu lima taumatau;

verses.en: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.
verses.sm: afai ou te le manatua oe, ia pipii ae loʻu laulaufaiva i loʻu gutu, pe a le faasili Ierusalema i mea uma ou te fiafia i ai.

verses.en: Remember, O LORD, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.
verses.sm: Le ALI e, ia e manatu i le fanauga a Etoma i le aso o lerusalema; na latou faapea ane ai, Ia faataatitiaina, ia faataatitiaina, ia oo i ona faavae.

verses.en: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.
verses.sm: Le tama fafine a Papelonia e, e faatafunaina oe; amuia o le faatatau ia te oe le taui na e taui mai ai ia te Í matou.

verses.en: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.
verses.sm: o Amuia le tago i au tama meamea, ma palasi ia te i latou i le papa.
